name: Maneesha Maviladath
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: A mature, professional counsellor with deep empathy and commitment to advocating and promoting mental health and wellbeing. I am experienced in supporting people across Australia from diverse cultures, languages, ethnicity, religion, race, gender and socio-economic background, who are going through complex mental health and other challenges. Whether you are experiencing the impacts of trauma, grief, going through relationship challenges, experiencing low moods, lack of motivation, having work stress, feeling anxious, burnt-out or just stuck, we can work together collaboratively to find what works for you to live a fuller life, meeting your goals and needs. My approach is integrative, person centred, trauma-informed, and strength based.

description: I support children, adolescents, adults, couples, and families navigating challenges such as anxiety, depression, trauma, grief and loss, emotional regulation difficulties, ADHD, ASD, OCD, behavioural concerns, stress, anger, self-esteem, socialisation skills, and life transitions.
